headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 23 studies yielded an effect size of 0.86 (95% CI: 0.75–1.0), indicating no statistically significant association between selenium and prostate cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by very high heterogeneity (I² = 85.22%), reflecting highly inconsistent results across studies.
